youtube.title: Why Honey Never Goes Bad 🍯 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Honey can last thousands of years without going bad.

Archaeologists have found pots of honey in ancient Egyptian tombs. The secret: honey has almost no water. It pulls water out of any germ that lands in it. It's also acidic, and bees add an enzyme that makes a little hydrogen peroxide. Bees even fan the honey with their wings to dry it out before sealing it. So the honey in your kitchen could outlive you.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
